questions.prompt: Is there a defect in the per-line rendering hot path that would show up when profiling a large billing run? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
An invoice in JPY has one line: unitAmountMinor 1500, quantity 2. What numeric value is passed to fmt.format for the line total?
Subtotal is 999 minor units and taxRateBps is 825 (8.25%). What is taxMinor?
choices: 82, because Math.round rounds 82.4175 to the nearest integer

questions.prompt: One invoice in a batch throws during rendering. How does that affect p95Ms?
choices: Its elapsed time is still recorded, because timings are pushed in finally
It is excluded, because only successful renders are timed
The whole batch reports p95Ms of 0
It is recorded as Infinity so failures dominate the percentile
